intro.say: Inside your body there are bones. Let's find out what they do!

rounds.say: Inside you are lots of hard bones. All your bones together are called your skeleton. It holds you up, like a frame!
rounds.caption: Skeleton = all my bones

rounds.say: Without bones you would be floppy like a jelly. Bones help you stand tall!
rounds.caption: Bones hold me up

options.label: Soft
options.why: Bones are not soft like a cloud. Tap your knee and feel!

rounds.explain: Bones are hard and strong, that is how they hold you up.

rounds.ask: What do we call all our bones together?

options.label: Lungs
options.why: Lungs help us breathe.

options.label: Brain
options.why: The brain helps us think.

rounds.explain: All of your bones together make your skeleton.

rounds.ask: Which one of these is a bone?

options.label: Apple
options.why: An apple is a food.

options.label: Teddy
options.why: A teddy is a soft toy.

rounds.explain: That is a bone, hard and strong.

rounds.ask: What would happen if you had no bones?

options.label: Fly away
options.why: Bones hold us up. They do not make us fly.

options.label: Turn colours
options.why: Bones do not change our colour.

rounds.explain: Without bones your body could not stand up, it would be floppy.

rounds.ask: Is it hard like a bone, or soft like a pillow?
rounds.explain: Bones are hard, like a rock or a nut shell.

intro.say: Bones keep soft parts safe, and muscles help you move!

rounds.say: Some bones are like helmets. Your skull is a hard bony case that keeps your brain safe.
rounds.caption: Skull protects brain

rounds.say: Your ribs are like a cage. They protect your heart and lungs inside your chest.
rounds.caption: Ribs protect heart and lungs

rounds.say: Muscles are joined to your bones. When a muscle pulls, your bone moves! That is how you wave, walk and jump.
rounds.caption: Muscles pull bones

rounds.ask: Which bone keeps your brain safe?

options.label: Ribs
options.why: Ribs keep your heart and lungs safe.

options.label: Leg bone
options.why: Leg bones hold you up when you stand.

rounds.explain: The skull is a hard case around your brain.

options.label: Feet
options.why: Feet are far from your ribs.

options.label: Eyes
options.why: Your eyes are kept safe by your skull.

rounds.explain: Your ribs make a cage around your heart and lungs.

options.label: Water
options.why: Water does not move your bones.

options.label: Teeth
options.why: Teeth are for chewing.

rounds.explain: Muscles pull on bones to move them.

options.label: Nothing
options.why: Even small moves use muscles!

rounds.explain: Running uses lots of leg muscles pulling on leg bones.

rounds.ask: Does this bone protect, or help you move?
rounds.explain: The skull and ribs protect, legs, feet and hands help us move.

intro.say: Let's think hard about joints, muscles, and how to keep bones strong.

rounds.say: Where two bones meet there is a joint, like your knee or elbow. Joints let you bend!
rounds.caption: Knee · Elbow · Joints

rounds.say: Exercise makes muscles stronger. Milk, cheese and yogurt have calcium, which helps bones grow strong.
rounds.caption: Move + calcium = strong

rounds.ask: Where is a joint that lets your arm bend?

options.label: Fingernail
options.why: Fingernails are not joints.

options.label: Nose
options.why: Your nose does not bend like that.

rounds.explain: Your elbow is a joint, where arm bones meet and bend.

rounds.ask: Which food helps build strong bones?

options.label: Lollipop
options.why: Sweets do not help bones grow.

options.label: Fizzy drink
options.why: Fizzy drinks do not help bones.

rounds.explain: Milk has calcium, which helps bones get strong.

rounds.ask: Mia plays football every day. What happens to her leg muscles?

options.label: Get floppier
options.why: Using muscles makes them stronger, not floppier.

options.label: Turn to bone
options.why: Muscles stay muscles.

rounds.explain: Using muscles a lot makes them grow stronger.

rounds.ask: Why is it good to wear a helmet when you ride a bike?

options.label: Looks nice
options.why: It may look nice, but there is a more important reason.

options.label: Makes legs fast
options.why: A helmet does not make you faster.

rounds.explain: A helmet adds extra protection for your skull and brain.

rounds.ask: Your heart is a muscle too! What does it never do?

options.label: Beat
options.why: Your heart beats all the time.

rounds.explain: Your heart muscle keeps working all day and all night.
rounds.hint: Think about when you are asleep.

rounds.ask: Put these in order: how does your arm lift a cup?
rounds.explain: Your brain tells the muscle to pull, the muscle moves the bone, and up goes the cup!
